title: 第21章 长青诀再现第22章 完美筑基
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 长青诀！
莫凡万万没想到，在这里竟然又遇到长青诀。
长青诀居然是来自仙界的功法！
青荻看着莫凡惊讶的表情，微微一笑：“我观你之灵力，其中蕴含着长青诀的气息。你目前所修炼功法，正是长青诀，对否？”
既然被看出来了，莫凡坦然点头：“晚辈在宗门里得到一部功法，正是长青诀。可惜，只有前三卷。”
青荻微微点头，道：“看来，你我相遇，也是注定。我这就把完整的长青诀传给你。”
说罢，他一抬手，一道白芒冲入莫凡脑海。
莫凡神识稍加查探，就看到密密麻麻的文字组成的法诀——长青诀，一共九卷，完整的长青诀！
青荻再次抬手，又一道白芒没入陆飞烟的脑海。九天玄女经，也传给了陆飞烟。
最后，青荻又拿出一枚戒指，用灵力将戒指送到莫凡面前：“此戒中有一些丹药、武技，如何分配使用，你二人看着办吧。”
“此外，我传与你二人的功法、武技，在此界应该可以使用。但是到了上界，在有足够的自保之力前，则尽量少用，以免被无霜和慕容夜发现。”
莫凡和陆飞烟一起抱拳躬身：“谢前辈！晚辈定当竭尽全力！”
想了一想，青荻继续说道：“我观这玄武大陆，修士实力低微至极，功法武技都极为缺乏，也没有什么术法，武器也非剑即刀，说这里是修真荒漠也不为过。上界比这里精彩数万倍，竞争压力也大数万倍。不过，修炼了我给你二人的功法，你们不仅可傲视玄武大陆，就是到了上界，起点也不会太低。期待你们在上界大放异彩。保重了。”
说完这些，虚影缓缓地消散不见。
上界的一界之主，何其强大，也消散于天地间，让莫凡一阵唏嘘。
只是，在莫凡看来已经很强大的玄武大陆，在青荻前辈眼里却是修真荒漠一般的地方。这让莫凡对上界产生了强烈的期待。
收起情绪，莫凡查看青荻给的戒指。这一查看，莫凡吓了一跳。
这戒指里的空间，竟然有百丈见方。以界主之尊，普通人用的金币，自然是不屑于收藏，只有两座堆成小山一样的灵石，其中一堆灵石个头稍小，足有两三百万枚，另一堆灵石个头稍大，有数十万枚。
几排架子，上面摆放着两百多只玉瓶，里面装着的是丹药。
还有两排架子，摆放着二十来幅武技卷轴。
另外，还有一堆莫凡认不出的材料，应该是炼器用的。
此外，还有一些杂七杂八的东西。
莫凡拿着戒指的手有些颤抖。他深深吸了一口气，然后将戒指递给陆飞烟。
就算陆飞烟是大宗门出身，看到戒指里的东西，也浑身微微颤抖。
这天降巨富，对莫凡和陆飞烟来说，已经不是惊喜，而是惊吓了。
陆飞烟将戒指递给莫凡，颤声问道：“怎么办？”
莫凡稳了稳激动的心情，问道：“那两堆都是灵石？”
陆飞烟点点头：“都是灵石，个头比较小的，是中品灵石，个头比较大的，是上品灵石。而我们在上面石室里得到的那些也是中品灵石。下品、中品、上品灵石，兑换的比例是一百比一。”
我的个乖乖，在今天之前连下品灵石都没见过的莫凡，竟一下子有了这么多的中品、上品灵石，让莫凡觉得像在做梦。
“咱们还是老规矩，所有东西全部平分。”莫凡说完就要把戒指里的东西全部取出来。
content_en:
Everlasting secret!
Mo Fan never expected that he would encounter Evergreen Jue again here.
The Evergreen Technique is actually a technique from the immortal world!
Qingdi looked at Mo Fan's surprised expression and smiled slightly: "I see that your spiritual power contains the aura of Evergreen Technique. The technique you are currently practicing is the Evergreen Technique, right?"
Now that he has been seen, Mo Fan nodded calmly: "This junior got a skill in the sect, which is the Evergreen Technique. Unfortunately, there are only the first three volumes."
Qingdi nodded slightly and said: "It seems that it is destined that you and I meet. I will pass on the complete Evergreen Secret to you right now."
After saying that, he raised his hand and a white light rushed into Mo Fan's mind.
After Mo Fan's spiritual consciousness searched for a while, he saw the dense text composed of the secret formula - Evergreen Secret. There are nine volumes in total, the complete Evergreen Secret!
Qing Di raised her hand again, and another white light entered Lu Feiyan's mind. The Nine Heavens Mysterious Girl Sutra was also passed on to Lu Feiyan.
Finally, Qingdi took out another ring and used her spiritual power to send it to Mo Fan: "This ring contains some elixirs and martial arts. It's up to you two to figure out how to distribute them."
"In addition, the techniques and martial arts I passed on to you should be usable in this world. But in the upper world, until you have enough power to protect yourself, try to use them as little as possible to avoid being discovered by Wu Shuang and Murong Ye."
Mo Fan and Lu Feiyan cupped their fists and bowed together: "Thank you, senior! I will do my best for this junior!"
After thinking for a while, Qingdi continued: "From my perspective, in this Xuanwu Continent, the strength of the monks is extremely low, their martial arts and martial arts are extremely lacking, and there are no magic techniques. The weapons are either swords or knives. It is not an exaggeration to say that this is a desert of cultivation. The upper world is much better than here. It’s tens of thousands times more exciting, and the competition pressure is tens of thousands times greater. However, after practicing the techniques I gave you, you will not only be able to stand out in the Xuanwu Continent, but your starting point will not be too low even when you reach the upper world. Take care.”
After saying this, the shadow slowly disappeared.
The Lord of the Upper Realm, so powerful, also dissipated between heaven and earth, making Mo Fan sigh.
However, in the eyes of Mo Fan, the Xuanwu Continent, which is already very powerful, is like a desert-like place for cultivation in the eyes of Senior Qingdi. This made Mo Fan have strong expectations for the upper world.
Putting away his emotions, Mo Fan checked the ring given by Qingdi. After checking it, Mo Fan was shocked.
The space in this ring is actually a hundred feet square. As a Realm Lord, he naturally disdains the collection of gold coins used by ordinary people. There are only two spiritual stones piled up like a hill. One of the piles of spiritual stones is slightly smaller, with two to three million pieces, and the other pile of spiritual stones is slightly larger, with hundreds of thousands of pieces.
There are several rows of shelves with more than two hundred jade bottles containing elixirs.
There are also two rows of shelves holding about twenty martial arts scrolls.
In addition, there was a pile of materials that Mo Fan could not recognize, which should be used for refining weapons.
In addition, there are some miscellaneous things.
Mo Fan's hand holding the ring was trembling. He took a deep breath and handed the ring to Lu Feiyan.
Even though Lu Feiyan was from a large sect, he trembled slightly when he saw what was in the ring.
For Mo Fan and Lu Feiyan, being rich from the sky was no longer a surprise, but a shock.
Lu Feiyan handed the ring to Mo Fan and asked in a trembling voice: "What should I do?"
Mo Fan calmed down his excitement and asked: "Are those two piles of spiritual stones?"
Lu Feiyan nodded: "They are all spiritual stones. The smaller ones are medium-grade spiritual stones, and the larger ones are high-grade spiritual stones. And the ones we got in the stone chamber above are also medium-grade spiritual stones. The exchange ratio for low-grade, medium-grade, and high-grade spiritual stones is one hundred to one."
My dear, Mo Fan, who had never even seen low-grade spiritual stones before today, suddenly had so many mid-grade and high-grade spiritual stones, which made Mo Fan feel like he was dreaming.
"We still follow the old rules and divide everything equally." After Mo Fan finished speaking, he took out all the things in the ring.
